title: Ice Collection
description: A fully configurable and complete ice collection system with an integrated scoreboard (that can be disabled).
body:
This plugin adds an unique, fully **configurable ice collection** with a **leaderboard** and **scoreboard**.

A **/leaderboard** command that shows the top 3 players with the most ice collection on the world with their ice count.

A **/ice** command to **manage any player's ice count**. **Set, add or remove** any count to their ice collection;

A system to detect if a block was placed to not give ice collection.

This plugin contains a **configuration file**, to fully customize the amount of "ice collection" each ice blocks gives, but also **customize the scoreboard**: from it's **title** to it's **contents**.
